scope: Internal native evidence for Ebisumaru bomb child ordering, direct explosion birth/resource initialization, explosion visual/contact modes, expiry, and the ordinary player damage route. This record is not public page content.

proofs.scope: File42 bomb and blast callbacks; direct-child constructor field order; explosion model/mode setup, contact geometry, life expiry; native collision and player health intake.

Focused confirmation that the native bomb delete wrapper is entered after both blast children are fully configured and before task cleanup/unlinking, and that parent entity and model identifiers are copied independently.

functions.name: func_08000E2C_6F103C
functions.abi: void(task pointer in a0, object pointer in a1)
functions.observed: When its ground-status gate clears, constructs group-0 visual child, then group-1 contact child, then deletes the bomb parent. Children inherit bomb transform. The callback does not select a player target.

functions.name: func_08000B58_6F0D68
functions.abi: void(task pointer in a0, object pointer in a1)
functions.observed: Uses model resource 0x0191, variant 8, and signed task halfword +0x8A initialized to 30. Mode flag 0x01/group 0 is visual with outgoing kind 0; mode flag 0x04/group 1 installs a stored-radius-120 local contact descriptor on its first phase-1 update and sets outgoing kind 1. The mode-4 damage byte is 1. On a phase-1 update whose entry life is zero, the callback removes the task.

functions.name: func_80218C28_5D40F8
functions.observed: On direct File42 blast construction, task bank+0x28 and resource base+0x2C are zero at helper entry. It copies context; the allocator then writes pending sentinels 0xFFFE/0xFFFFFFFF and the File42 caller later installs bank 0x2A and its resident resource base. Entity +0x5C and model +0x5E are copied independently from the corresponding parent fields; equality is not guaranteed.

functions.name: func_802171A8_5D2678
functions.observed: For the direct File42 explosion-child path, invokes context inheritance before storing bank 0xFFFE/base 0xFFFFFFFF; the File42 caller changes these to bank 0x2A and the resident File42 base after return.

functions.name: func_801D9E9C_595DAC
functions.observed: Accepted ordinary type-1 player contact from the group-1 explosion follows native defense/invulnerability gates and invokes the signed health adjuster with -1. The contact scan itself does not subtract health.

functions.name: func_80034ED4_35AD4
functions.abi: void(void); uses the current-task global as the cleanup argument
functions.observed: The Ebisumaru bomb callback calls this wrapper only after both direct explosion children have completed overlay/mode/resource setup. First wrapper entry occurs before descendant cleanup and unlinking; the verified native bomb path does not set task status +0x68 bit 0x02 before entry.

limitations: The local proof is static analysis; no callback was replayed and no gameplay run or multiplayer test was performed.
A radius-120 descriptor is local and object-scale transformed, not a fixed world-space radius.
Visual explosion creation does not prove damaging contact was accepted; native collision and player intake keep their normal gates.
No raw callback, task pointer, object pointer, or scheduler identity should be treated as a portable remote actor reference.
